 "rationale": "Two stages give ~76 dB with L≈1-1.5 um loads. Cc=1 pF and gm1≈160 uS give GBW≈25 MHz. A 22 uA tail gives SR≈22 V/us. A 100 uA, 1 mS second stage puts p2 at about 2x GBW, and Rz≈2/gm7 adds a LHP zero, so PM is above 60. The PMOS mirror/PMOS CS pair makes the second-stage Vsg track VDD for good PSRR. A large-area, L=1 input pair keeps 1/f noise low. Total current is about 135 uA."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L (area -> flicker)
    "Itail": (22e-6, 15e-6, 40e-6),  # first-stage tail current
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.6e-12, 1.6e-12),
    "I7":    (100e-6, 60e-6, 200e-6),# second-stage current
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror / M7 length
    "Lb":    (1.5, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS bias mirror length
    "rz_k":  (2.0, 1.0, 3.5),        # Rz = rz_k / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I1, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["Itail"] / 2, p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    gmid_p, gmid_b = 10.0, 12.0

    # ---- devices ----
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)        # input pair
    m3 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], I1, vds=1.0)                      # PMOS mirror (diode)
    m3.vds = m3.vgs
    m3 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], I1, vds=m3.vgs)
    m4 = m3                                                                # mirror output (vds≈vsg by symmetry)
    m7 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)                       # 2nd stage CS (same gm/Id, L as M3)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.7)                     # reference diode
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Lb"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Lb"], It, vds=0.2)                       # tail
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Lb"], I7, vds=0.9)                       # 2nd-stage load
    Rz = p["rz_k"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # first stage: vinp drives the mirror-output side so output is non-inverting overall
    # M1 (vinn) -> diode side d1 ; M2 (vinp) -> n1 ; n1 drives PMOS CS (inverting) -> vout
    # vinp up -> I(M2) up -> n1 down -> vout up : non-inverting. Correct.
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    a2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd + m3.cgg * 0.0
    Cout = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + C1 * Cout + Cc * Cout))
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / gm7))          # LHP zero if Rz > 1/gm7
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * pmir)))
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    vth_n = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise = math.sqrt(vth_n**2 + (120e-9)**2)            # thermal + estimated 1/f at 1 kHz (large-area pair)
    psrr = gain - 6.0                                    # PMOS-referenced 2nd stage tracks VDD
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I7)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "noise_1k": noise, "psrr_db": psrr, "power": power}
```
